findings.issue_text: [Medium/performance] Normal cleanup batches are logged at Error level with the complete ids slice, causing enormous error logs, avoidable I/O/cost, and possible operational alerts for large batches.
[Medium/performance] Reducing the service ticker from 10 minutes to 1 minute makes cleanUpTmpFiles run ten times more often, causing unnecessary repeated filesystem scan/delete load.

goldens.comment: The code uses Error log level for what appears to be debugging information. This will pollute error logs in production. Consider using Debug or Info level instead.

The cleanup job ticker was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, which can lead to increased database load and contention due to more frequent execution of cleanup tasks. This change should be reviewed to ensure it aligns with performance expectations.

per_golden_matches.reasoning: Both comments identify the same issue: using Error log level inappropriately for non-error information. The candidate adds specific concerns about I/O costs and operational alerts, but the core issue is identical - Error level logging being misused for routine/debug information.
